proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: Lean (sibling) class field H3 *defines* `blockTrace` (named tr(A^λ_{μν}(I)·(ρ_μ(β₁)⊗ρ_ν(β₂)))) as the block-diagonal sum of the branched matrix, so `branch_trace` is just `Fintype.sum_sigma` (trace = sum of diagonal blocks). The content (that each diagonal block's trace equals tr(A(I)·(ρ_μ⊗ρ_ν))) is assumed; A, ρ_μ, ρ_ν, the LR multiplicities do not appear. Proof: the identity is true (β₁, β₂ ∈ H_n⊗H_m act block-diagonally, so tr of the (p,p) block of β₁Iβ₂ = tr(I_pp·(ρ_μ(β₁)⊗ρ_ν(β₂))) by cyclicity), but the proof's "the action … on the (μ,ν) component factors as A(I)·(ρ_μ⊗ρ_ν)" is wrong as stated: I is not block-diagonal; only the diagonal block, after cyclic rearrangement, has that form. Corollary's Pythagorean formula divides by d_μd_ν where the block has dimension c^λ_{μν}·d_μd_ν
